advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Update docs/exit-codes.md to document the new `--require-live` exit-1 case: live available but zero selected criteria completed successfully.
evidence: docs/exit-codes.md:176: 'with `--require-live`, selected criteria that cannot run live (no LLM backend/credentials) -> 1 (otherwise a stderr warning and 0)' — describes only the no-backend failure, not the zero-successful-eval failure
advisory.finding: docs/exit-codes.md documents the `criteria eval --changed-since --require-live` exit-1 condition only as 'selected criteria that cannot run live (no LLM backend/credentials) -> 1', but the diff adds a NEW exit-1 mode: live was available and attempted yet every selected criterion errored ('no selected live criteria completed successfully'). The operator-facing exit-code table no longer fully describes the command's failure surface.
scenarios: A Bedrock-only CI job runs --require-live, live is considered available, all criteria error, and the job exits 1 for a reason the exit-code doc does not enumerate.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test asserting `criteria eval <id> --changed-since ""` (empty string) exits 2 with the mutual-exclusion message, pinning the `is not None` change.
evidence: src/rebar/_cli/_llm_eval_commands.py:173: `if args.criterion_id and args.changed_since is not None:`

tests/unit/test_changed_criteria.py:258-259: `["rebar", "criteria", "eval", "T8", "--changed-since", base]` uses a real non-empty ref, so it passes under both the old truthy check and the new `is not None` check
Named violating input: `criteria eval T8 --changed-since ""` (empty string) — under the new code returns 2, under the old code would not trip the guard; no test asserts this.
advisory.finding: The changed mutual-exclusion guard `args.criterion_id and args.changed_since is not None` (was truthy `and args.changed_since`) newly makes `criteria eval <id> --changed-since ""` return 2, but no test exercises the empty-string-with-id case; the existing mutual-exclusion test uses a non-empty ref (`base`) and would pass under both the old and new predicate, so this diff's behavioral distinction is not gated.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Update the `criteria` row in docs/exit-codes.md to document that `--require-live` also returns 1 when live evals were attempted but every selected criterion errored (zero completed successfully).
evidence: src/rebar/_cli/_llm_eval_commands.py:279-281 (diff): `if args.require_live and completed == 0:` writes 'Error: no selected live criteria completed successfully' and `return 1` — a new exit-1 condition distinct from missing backend/credentials
docs/exit-codes.md:176: the `criteria` row lists only 'with `--require-live`, selected criteria that cannot run live (no LLM backend/credentials) → 1' and does not mention the all-errored live case
docs/exit-codes.md:6: 'This document is the single source of truth for what each code means and which code each subcommand emits.'
advisory.finding: docs/exit-codes.md's `criteria` row (the declared single source of truth for the command's exit codes) does not document the newly added exit-1 path where `--require-live` is set, a live backend is available, but every selected live criterion errors ('no selected live criteria completed successfully').
scenarios: An agent or CI job runs `criteria eval --changed-since <ref> --require-live` where the live backend is configured but all selected criteria error; it now receives exit 1 for a reason the exit-code contract does not describe.
advisory.suggested_fix: In docs/exit-codes.md line 176, extend the `criteria` row's `--require-live` clause to add: and when a live backend is available but every selected criterion errors (zero completed) → 1.
